5x1 apps

BEep for Jibo robots running 5x1, from apps.5x1.com. Includes BEep BETA, which gets every change first. These are the same signed APKs as the website's downloads.

Currently it serves 2 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://apps.5x1.com/fdroid/repo
